CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_csi(p_cntref CHAR(12))
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $ $
DECLARE
    v_total_score NUMERIC;
    v_score_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
    -- Initialize variables
    v_total_score := 0;
    v_score_count := 0;

    -- Fetch scores from ContentBehavior
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(cntsimscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(cntuniqscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(cntdiverseval, 0) 
    INTO v_total_score
    FROM ContentBehavior
    WHERE cntref = p_cntref;

    -- Update score count based on fetched scores
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) 
    INTO v_score_count
    FROM ContentBehavior
    WHERE cntref = p_cntref
    AND (cntsimscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        cntuniqscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        cntdiverseval IS NOT NULL);

    -- Fetch scores from ModerationAction
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(netinflscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(coordscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(authenscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(credscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(reputscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(trustval, 0) + 
        COALESCE(impactval, 0)
    INTO v_total_score
    FROM ModerationAction
    WHERE macntref = p_cntref;

    -- Update score count based on fetched scores
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) 
    INTO v_score_count
    FROM ModerationAction
    WHERE macntref = p_cntref
    AND (netinflscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        coordscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        authenscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        credscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        reputscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        trustval IS NOT NULL OR 
        impactval IS NOT NULL);

    -- Fetch scores from MessagingAnalysis
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(msgsimscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(msgfreq, 0) + 
        COALESCE(msgtgtdiv, 0) + 
        COALESCE(convnatval, 0) + 
        COALESCE(sentvar, 0) + 
        COALESCE(langsoph, 0) + 
        COALESCE(txtuniq, 0) + 
        COALESCE(topiccoh, 0)
    INTO v_total_score
    FROM MessagingAnalysis
    WHERE msgcntref = p_cntref;

    -- Update score count based on fetched scores
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) 
    INTO v_score_count
    FROM MessagingAnalysis
    WHERE msgcntref = p_cntref
    AND (msgsimscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        msgfreq IS NOT NULL OR 
        msgtgtdiv IS NOT NULL OR 
        convnatval IS NOT NULL OR 
        sentvar IS NOT NULL OR 
        langsoph IS NOT NULL OR 
        txtuniq IS NOT NULL OR 
        topiccoh IS NOT NULL);

    -- Handle division by zero
    IF v_score_count = 0 THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    ELSE
        RETURN v_total_score / v_score_count;
    END IF;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        -- Log error and return NULL on exception
        RAISE WARNING 'Error calculating CSI for %: %', p_cntref, SQLERRM;
        RETURN NULL;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

    SELECT
